title: %substring — extract by start and length
purpose: Return the slice of a string starting at an index for a given length.
notes: Three required arguments: string, zero-based start index, then length (not an end index).
All three are required — a two-argument call returns null.

avoid.why: second arg is start and third is length, not start/end; ##3 ##1 starts at index 3 for length 1 → "d", not "ond"
